XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for Moodle Methodos activity module

TABLE.NAME: methodos
TABLE.COMMENT: Defines Methodos peer review activity instances

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique identifier for this activity instance

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key referencing the course this activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity instance

FIELD.NAME: ltiinstanceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Reference to the shadow mod_lti instance ID

FIELD.NAME: projectid
FIELD.COMMENT: Linked Methodos project/workspace token or ID

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was created

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified

KEY.NAME: primary
KEY.COMMENT: Primary key for the methodos table

INDEX.NAME: course
INDEX.COMMENT: Index on course field to speed up course lookups
